acv.quote: About a hundred and forty K a year.

header.reason: Won once Wen used Tallowfield's own statements to put a yearly cost on manual deposit matching, and Ines accepted it. Dana's early portal pitch had nearly stalled the deal.

findings.label: What started it
findings.finding: Aim messaging at new CFOs stuck with a slow month-end close.
findings.why: Ines's first close took nine days, partly from hand-matching deposits. The portal Dana pitched was just the excuse.
findings.quote: her first month-end close took nine days

findings.label: Who decided
findings.finding: Put the finance payoff on page one for the CFO.
findings.why: Paul forwarded a portal-focused proposal to Ines. She read the first page and said it wasn't her problem.

findings.label: The competitor
findings.finding: Offer a named contact where the bank only talks about rates.
findings.why: Ines's bank offered to look at rates, then she asked us for a named contact. Dana never saw Fiserv's pitch.
findings.quote: I didn't ask about my rates.

findings.label: Our message
findings.finding: Cut the global infrastructure opening and lead with payout reconciliation.
findings.why: The standard deck got silence. Ines stopped Wen mid-demo to see the reconciliation again.
findings.quote: Ines actually stopped him and said, 'go back.'

findings.label: Missing proof
findings.finding: Build a distributor reference customers can call.
findings.why: Ines asked twice to talk to another distributor. Dana only had a retail case study to send.
findings.quote: this is a company that sells sweaters.

findings.label: Their words
findings.finding: Say 'deposits' and 'where my money is', not 'payments'.
findings.why: Ines never said payments or infrastructure. She called month-end a week of archaeology.
findings.quote: I just want to know where my money is.
